item.title: Kathara Deftera (Clean Monday) 2026
item.description: Kathara Deftera (Καθαρά Δευτέρα), also known as Clean Monday, Pure Monday, or Green Monday, is today—February 23, 2026! It's a major public holiday in Greece and Cyprus, marking the official start of Great Lent (Sarakosti) in the Eastern Orthodox Church. This day signals the end of the Carnival (Apokries) festivities and the beginning of a period of fasting and spiritual preparation leading up to Orthodox Easter (Pascha). item.title: Greece Hits 53% of EU Recovery Fund Milestones as 2026 Deadline Nears
item.description: As the EU's Recovery and Resilience Facility nears its August 2026 end, Greece reports 53% milestone completion (204 out of total) under Greece 2.0. With €24.57B in expected disbursements and strong SME support, the government vows no euro lost amid pressure to finalize reforms. item.title: Trump International Hotel Tower Gold Coast to Become Australia’s Tallest Building at 335m
item.description: The Trump family, in partnership with Altus Property Group, has secured approval to construct the 91-storey Trump International Hotel Tower on the Gold Coast. Rising 335 metres, the development will become Australia’s tallest building, featuring a 285-room luxury hotel, 272 residences, commercial space and an exclusive beach club.
